name: csv-quoted-fields
prompt: Bug report: importing contacts fails when a company name contains a comma, e.g. "Acme, Inc." - the row gets an extra column. Make parseCsv in src/csv.js follow RFC 4180 quoting: a quoted field may contain commas, line breaks and doubled quotes ("" stands for one quote character). Accept both LF and CRLF line endings, and don't produce an empty row for a trailing line break.
